question_record.context: A known credential theft tool was executed on host `vnevado-win10v` under the account `tgs2z`, indicating an intent to dump credentials. Additionally, a process suspiciously stopped services on this host, likely to avoid detection and facilitate data encryption or destruction. This sequence of malicious activities culminated in an attack that involved a replication request sent from VNEVADO-Win10V to VNEVADO-DC.
question_record.question: Which individual was responsible for sending the replication request from VNEVADO-Win10V to VNEVADO-DC?
solution: A credential theft tool was executed using `powershell.exe` command line.
A suspicious process was detected, involving the account with AadUserId `7fcf9695-68fc-4258-864d-e1e5b166c66f`, that stopped services on the device.
A suspected DCSync attack was performed by Julian Burke (IT director) from VNEVADO-Win10V, as he sent 1 replication request to VNEVADO-DC.

104.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
104.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

46.name: Suspicious process stopping services
46.description: A process suspiciously stopped services running on the device. An attacker might stop a service to avoid detection, removal of malware, and recovery. This is often done in conjunction with data encryption or destruction, to render the device unusable.

122.name: Suspected DCSync attack (replication of directory services)
122.description: Julian Burke (IT director) on VNEVADO-Win10V sent 1 replication request to VNEVADO-DC.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Name' AND o.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
